entries.template: Among {totalObjects} distinct people, two specified pairs must each stand together, but the two formed pair-blocks must not be adjacent to one another. How many linear arrangements are possible?

Among {totalObjects} distinct performers, one specified pair and one separate specified trio must each remain together, but the two formed blocks must not be adjacent. How many linear arrangements are possible?

In a row of {totalObjects} distinct people, a specified group of {blockSize} must stand together, while one other specified person must not stand immediately beside that block. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} distinct files, one specified pair must remain together, while a separate specified trio must not all appear consecutively. How many linear arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} distinct people, there are two specified disjoint pairs. In how many linear arrangements is at least one of those pairs not together?

Two specified pairs among \(n\) distinct people must each remain together, but the two pair-blocks must not be adjacent. If the number of arrangements is {target}, find \(n\), where \(5 \le n \le 8\).
